name: Mang rung
summary: Măng rừng, forest bamboo shoot, is one of the specialties sold at the Mang Den weekend market. Dried măng le is sold as a separate product.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoDescription: Măng rừng, forest bamboo shoot, at the Mang Den weekend market. Dried măng le is a separate product.
